body.message:
Hello Lawson,

Please note that date changes are subject to availability. If you would like to change your dates at a later stage, we will first check the availability for your requested new dates.

Kindly note that if the rates for the new dates are higher than your original booking, the difference in rate will be applicable as an additional charge. If the rates remain the same, we will be happy to assist with the date change accordingly.

Regarding cancellations, due to the current market conditions, we are unable to offer flexible cancellation terms. Once the booking is confirmed, it will be considered non-refundable.

We kindly recommend confirming your dates and plans before proceeding with the booking.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
